title: Varif.ai to Vary and Verify User-Driven Diversity in Scalable Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from occupational prompts (e.g., 'doctors'), using CLIP to classify the generated images into gender labels, and comparing the resulting distribution against user-defined diversity targets using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence.

Generating images of people and using a vision-language model (CLIP) to classify them into LLM-suggested racial/ethnic labels (e.g., Caucasian, Black, Asian, Hispanic), then evaluating the distribution's alignment with targeted diversity goals.

Classifying generated images of people into various age group labels (e.g., 30s, 40s, 50s) using CLIP and measuring the label distribution to assess and mitigate the overrepresentation of specific age groups.
